321: 	setupKeyHandlers(): void {
322: 		this.#draftText ??= this.ctx.editor.getText();
323: 		this.ctx.editor.setActionKeys("app.interrupt", this.ctx.keybindings.getKeys("app.interrupt"));
324: 		if (!this.#focusedLeftTapListenerInstalled) {
325: 			this.#focusedLeftTapListenerInstalled = true;
326: 			this.ctx.ui.addInputListener(data => {
327: 				if (!this.ctx.focusedAgentId) return undefined;
328: 				if (!matchesKey(data, "left")) return undefined;
329: 				if (this.ctx.editor.getText().trim()) return undefined;
330: 				this.#handleFocusedLeftTap();
331: 				return { consume: true };
332: 			});
333: 		}
334: 		if (!this.#btwBranchListenerInstalled) {
335: 			this.#btwBranchListenerInstalled = true;
336: 			this.ctx.ui.addInputListener(data => {
337: 				if (!matchesKey(data, "b")) return undefined;
338: 				if (!this.ctx.handlesBtwBranchKey()) return undefined;
339: 				if (this.ctx.ui.getFocused() !== this.ctx.editor) return undefined;
340: 				if (this.ctx.editor.getText().trim()) return undefined;
341: 				void this.ctx.handleBtwBranchKey();
342: 				return { consume: true };
343: 			});
344: 		}
345: 		if (!this.#btwCopyListenerInstalled) {
346: 			this.#btwCopyListenerInstalled = true;
347: 			this.ctx.ui.addInputListener(data => {
348: 				if (this.ctx.ui.getFocused() !== this.ctx.editor) return undefined;
349: 				if (this.ctx.editor.getText().trim()) return undefined;
350: 				if (matchesKey(data, "f") && this.ctx.canFollowUpBtw()) {
351: 					this.ctx.handleBtwFollowUpKey();
352: 					return { consume: true };
353: 				}
354: 				if (!matchesKey(data, "c") || !this.ctx.canCopyBtw()) return undefined;
355: 				void this.ctx.handleBtwCopyKey();
356: 				return { consume: true };
357: 			});
358: 		}
359: 		if (!this.#focusedPasteListenerInstalled) {
360: 			this.#focusedPasteListenerInstalled = true;
361: 			this.ctx.ui.addInputListener(data => {
362: 				const focused = this.ctx.ui.getFocused();
363: 				if (!focused || focused === this.ctx.editor || !hasPasteText(focused)) return undefined;
364: 				if (!this.ctx.keybindings.matches(data, "app.clipboard.pasteImage")) return undefined;
365: 				void this.handleImagePaste();
366: 				return { consume: true };
367: 			});
368: 		}
369: 		if (!this.#globalEditorActionsListenerInstalled) {
370: 			this.#globalEditorActionsListenerInstalled = true;
371: 			// These actions target the main transcript/editor rather than the
372: 			// focused prompt. Keep focused components' own bindings authoritative.
373: 			this.ctx.ui.addInputListener(data => {
374: 				if (this.ctx.keybindings.matches(data, "app.thinking.toggle")) {
375: 					if (this.ctx.ui.hasOverlay()) return undefined;
376: 					this.ctx.toggleThinkingBlockVisibility();
377: 					return { consume: true };
378: 				}
379: 				if (this.ctx.keybindings.matches(data, "app.history.search")) {
380: 					if (this.ctx.ui.hasOverlay() || this.ctx.ui.getFocused() instanceof HistorySearchComponent) {
381: 						return undefined;
382: 					}
383: 					this.ctx.showHistorySearch();
384: 					return { consume: true };
385: 				}
386: 				if (this.ctx.keybindings.matches(data, "app.editor.external")) {
387: 					if (this.ctx.ui.hasOverlay()) return undefined;
388: 					const focused = this.ctx.ui.getFocused();
389: 					if (
390: 						focused instanceof HookEditorComponent ||
391: 						focused === this.ctx.hookSelector ||
392: 						focused === this.ctx.hookInput
393: 					) {
394: 						return undefined;
395: 					}
396: 					void this.openExternalEditor();
397: 					return { consume: true };
398: 				}
399: 				if (this.ctx.keybindings.matches(data, "app.tools.toggleVisibility")) {
400: 					if (this.ctx.ui.hasOverlay()) return undefined;
401: 					const focused = this.ctx.ui.getFocused();
402: 					if (
403: 						focused instanceof TreeSelectorComponent &&
404: 						(matchesKey(data, "shift+ctrl+o") || matchesKey(data, "ctrl+shift+o"))
405: 					) {
406: 						return undefined;
407: 					}
408: 					this.toggleToolActivityVisibility();
409: 					return { consume: true };
410: 				}
411: 				if (this.ctx.keybindings.matches(data, "app.display.reset")) {
412: 					if (this.ctx.ui.hasOverlay()) return undefined;
413: 					// The tree selector rebinds Alt+L for its `labeled-only` filter
414: 					// and mounts inline (no overlay), so its own binding stays
415: 					// authoritative here — same defer as the tools toggle above.
416: 					if (this.ctx.ui.getFocused() instanceof TreeSelectorComponent && matchesKey(data, "alt+l"))
417: 						return undefined;
418: 					this.ctx.resetDisplayAfterAppearanceRefresh();
419: 					return { consume: true };
420: 				}
421: 				return undefined;
422: 			});
423: 		}
424: 		if (!this.#expandToolsListenerInstalled) {
425: 			this.#expandToolsListenerInstalled = true;
426: 			// `app.tools.expand` (Ctrl+O) toggles the transcript's tool-output
427: 			// preview. It must fire regardless of focus so a truncated edit stays
428: 			// expandable while an approval prompt / select dialog holds keyboard
429: 			// focus (#7837). Defers when the main transcript is not the active
430: 			// surface (a fullscreen/anchored overlay — agent hub, transcript
431: 			// viewer, log viewer, model picker) or when the focused component
432: 			// rebinds Ctrl+O for its own use (the tree selector's filter cycle).
433: 			this.ctx.ui.addInputListener(data => {
434: 				if (!this.ctx.keybindings.matches(data, "app.tools.expand")) return undefined;
435: 				if (this.ctx.ui.hasOverlay()) return undefined;
436: 				if (this.ctx.ui.getFocused() instanceof TreeSelectorComponent && matchesKey(data, "ctrl+o"))
437: 					return undefined;
438: 				const focused = this.ctx.ui.getFocused();
439: 				// A truncated ask question lives in the editor slot, not chat
440: 				// transcript, so expand it in-place instead of (or before)
441: 				// toggling tool-output previews.
442: 				if (focused instanceof AskDialogComponent && focused.toggleQuestionExpansion()) {
443: 					return { consume: true };
444: 				}
445: 				this.toggleToolOutputExpansion();
446: 				return { consume: true };
447: 			});
448: 		}
449: 		if (!this.#inlineMouseListenerInstalled) {
450: 			this.#inlineMouseListenerInstalled = true;
451: 			// Inline click-to-focus (`tui.mouse`): SGR reports only arrive while
452: 			// the setting has tracking enabled, so this stays inert otherwise.
453: 			// Defers to fullscreen overlays, which own mouse handling on the
454: 			// alternate screen.
455: 			this.ctx.ui.addInputListener(data => this.#handleInlineMouse(data));
456: 		}
457: 		this.ctx.editor.onEscape = () => {
458: 			// `/mcp test` advertises Esc until each owner's post-settlement grace expires.
459: 			// Cancel every overlapping test before any main-turn or side-channel action.
460: 			if (this.ctx.mcpTestEscapeHandlers.size > 0) {
461: 				// One Esc cancels every advertised /mcp test and consumes the ownership;
462: 				// the next Esc must reach the actions below instead of being swallowed
463: 				// by a stale registration or grace timer.
464: 				const handlers = [...this.ctx.mcpTestEscapeHandlers];
465: 				this.ctx.mcpTestEscapeHandlers.clear();
466: 				for (const handler of handlers) handler();
467: 				return;
468: 			}
469: 
470: 			// Side-channel panels own Esc for cancellation or closing before
471: 			// loop mode, maintenance, or the underlying main turn.
472: 			// Active context maintenance owns Esc: auto/manual compaction,
473: 			// handoff generation, and auto-retry backoff all advertise
474: 			// "(esc to cancel)". Dispatch on live session state instead of
475: 			// swapping onEscape handlers — interleaved start/end events used
476: 			// to clobber the single saved-handler slot (auto-compaction start
477: 			// → /compact → auto end → manual finally), leaving Esc wired to a
478: 			// stale no-op closure until restart.
479: 			//
480: 			// While a subagent is focused, Esc honors the advertised view action
481: 			// ("Esc returns to main") instead of cancelling maintenance —
482: 			// accidentally killing a focused subagent's compaction on the way out
483: 			// was #2819. The auto-maintenance loaders relabel their hint to match
484: 			// (see EventController). Main-session maintenance still owns Esc and
485: 			// stays cancellable from the main view (focused submit gates /compact
486: 			// and handoff, so manual maintenance is main-only anyway).
487: 			if (this.ctx.hasActiveBtw() && this.ctx.handleBtwEscape()) {
488: 				return;
489: 			}
490: 			if (this.ctx.hasActiveOmfg() && this.ctx.handleOmfgEscape()) {
491: 				return;
492: 			}
493: 			if (this.ctx.hasActiveCleanse() && this.ctx.handleCleanseEscape()) {
494: 				return;
495: 			}
496: 
497: 			if (!this.ctx.focusedAgentId) {
498: 				const viewSession = this.ctx.viewSession;
499: 				let aborted = false;
500: 				if (viewSession.isCompacting) {
501: 					safeAbort("compaction", () => viewSession.abortCompaction());
502: 					aborted = true;
503: 				}
504: 				if (viewSession.isGeneratingHandoff) {
505: 					safeAbort("handoff", () => viewSession.abortHandoff());
506: 					aborted = true;
507: 				}
508: 				if (viewSession.isRetrying) {
509: 					safeAbort("retry", () => viewSession.abortRetry());
510: 					aborted = true;
511: 				}
512: 				if (aborted) return;
513: 			}
514: 
515: 			if (vocalizer.isSpeaking()) {
516: 				// Playback from the completed response can overlap the next agent
517: 				// turn. Silence it before interrupting any ongoing main-turn work.
518: 				vocalizer.clear();
519: 				this.ctx.lastEscapeTime = 0;
520: 				return;
521: 			}
522: 
523: 			if (this.ctx.loopModeEnabled) {
524: 				// Esc suspends the loop even mid-iteration: abort the live turn,
525: 				// then drop the captured prompt so the 800ms auto-resubmit never
526: 				// fires. Loop stays enabled (paused) — the next manual prompt
527: 				// resumes with a new body.
528: 				if (this.ctx.session.isStreaming) {
529: 					this.#abortStreamingTurn();
530: 				}
531: 				this.ctx.pauseLoop();
532: 				this.ctx.cancelPendingSubmission();
533: 				return;
534: 			}
535: 			if (this.ctx.focusedAgentId) {
536: 				// Esc never interrupts the focused agent's turn: clear typed text,
537: 				// else return the view to the main session. Interrupt via empty
538: 				// steer-flush submit if needed.
539: 				if (this.ctx.editor.getText().trim()) {
540: 					this.ctx.editor.setText("");
541: 					this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
542: 				} else {
543: 					void this.ctx.unfocusSession();
544: 				}
545: 				return; // double-escape backtrack (/tree, /branch) stays main-only
546: 			}
547: 			if (this.ctx.collabGuest) {
548: 				// Guest Esc: ask the host to interrupt its agent; the local replica
549: 				// session is never streaming, so the native abort path below would
550: 				// no-op.
551: 				if (this.ctx.collabGuest.state?.isStreaming || this.ctx.loadingAnimation) {
552: 					this.ctx.collabGuest.sendAbort();
553: 				}
554: 				return;
555: 			}
556: 			if (this.ctx.loadingAnimation) {
557: 				if (this.ctx.cancelPendingSubmission()) {
558: 					return;
559: 				}
560: 				this.restoreQueuedMessagesToEditor({ abort: true });
561: 			} else if (this.ctx.session.isBashRunning) {
562: 				this.ctx.session.abortBash();
563: 			} else if (this.ctx.isBashMode) {
564: 				this.ctx.editor.setText("");
565: 				this.ctx.isBashMode = false;
566: 				this.ctx.updateEditorBorderColor();
567: 			} else if (this.ctx.session.isEvalRunning) {
568: 				this.ctx.session.abortEval();
569: 			} else if (this.ctx.isPythonMode) {
570: 				this.ctx.editor.setText("");
571: 				this.ctx.isPythonMode = false;
572: 				this.ctx.updateEditorBorderColor();
573: 			} else if (this.ctx.session.isStreaming) {
574: 				this.#abortStreamingTurn();
575: 			} else if (this.ctx.editor.getText().trim()) {
576: 				// Esc must not destroy an in-progress draft.
577: 				this.ctx.lastEscapeTime = 0;
578: 			} else {
579: 				// Double-interrupt with an empty editor runs the configured action:
580: 				// the transcript rewind selector (default) or the session tree.
581: 				const doubleEscapeAction = settings.get("doubleEscapeAction");
582: 				if (doubleEscapeAction !== "none") {
583: 					const now = Date.now();
584: 					if (now - this.ctx.lastEscapeTime < 500) {
585: 						if (doubleEscapeAction === "tree") {
586: 							this.ctx.showTreeSelector();
587: 						} else {
588: 							this.ctx.showUserMessageSelector();
589: 						}
590: 						// Forced viewport repaint only: `resetDisplay()` replays the whole
591: 						// committed transcript (and clears native scrollback on direct
592: 						// terminals), which blocks on PTY backpressure for tens of seconds
593: 						// on long sessions — the selector opens invisibly and double-Esc
594: 						// reads as dead. O(viewport) is enough to settle the editor-slot swap.
595: 						this.ctx.ui.requestRender(true);
596: 						this.ctx.lastEscapeTime = 0;
597: 					} else {
598: 						this.ctx.lastEscapeTime = now;
599: 					}
600: 				}
601: 			}
602: 		};

672: 			this.ctx.editor.setCustomKeyHandler(key, () => this.ctx.showUserMessageSelector());
673: 		}
674: 		for (const key of this.ctx.keybindings.getKeys("app.session.resume")) {
675: 			this.ctx.editor.setCustomKeyHandler(key, () => this.ctx.showSessionSelector());
676: 		}
677: 		for (const key of this.ctx.keybindings.getKeys("app.message.followUp")) {
678: 			this.ctx.editor.setCustomKeyHandler(key, () => void this.handleFollowUp());
679: 		}
680: 		for (const key of this.ctx.keybindings.getKeys("app.stt.toggle")) {
681: 			this.ctx.editor.setCustomKeyHandler(key, () => void this.ctx.handleSTTToggle());
682: 		}
683: 		for (const key of this.ctx.keybindings.getKeys("app.live.toggle")) {
684: 			this.ctx.editor.setCustomKeyHandler(key, () => void this.ctx.handleLiveCommand());
685: 		}
686: 		// Hold the space bar to push-to-talk: the editor recognizes the auto-repeat burst, tracks
687: 		// the spam back out, and toggles STT on hold start / release. Gated on `stt.enabled` so a
688: 		// disabled STT leaves the space bar typing normally.
689: 		this.ctx.editor.sttHoldEnabled = () => settings.get("stt.enabled");
690: 		this.ctx.editor.onSpaceHoldStart = () => void this.ctx.handleSTTToggle();
691: 		this.ctx.editor.onSpaceHoldEnd = () => void this.ctx.handleSTTToggle();
692: 		for (const key of this.ctx.keybindings.getKeys("app.clipboard.copyLine")) {
693: 			this.ctx.editor.setCustomKeyHandler(key, () => this.handleCopyCurrentLine());
694: 		}
695: 		const hubKeys = new Set([
696: 			...this.ctx.keybindings.getKeys("app.agents.hub"),
697: 			...this.ctx.keybindings.getKeys("app.session.observe"),
698: 		]);
699: 		for (const key of hubKeys) {
700: 			this.ctx.editor.setCustomKeyHandler(key, () => this.ctx.showAgentHub());
701: 		}
702: 
703: 		// Double-tap left arrow on an empty editor: opens the agent hub from the
704: 		// main session, or returns the focused subagent view to the main session.
705: 		// Focused ←← intentionally matches Esc. From the main session the gesture
706: 		// stays inert when there are no subagents (requireContent); the explicit
707: 		// hub key still opens the empty roster. `armCloseTap` hands this gesture's
708: 		// tap state to the hub so the same ←← that opened it also arms its close —
709: 		// otherwise the hub's fresh detector demands a second ←← (issue #4780).
710: 		this.ctx.editor.onLeftAtStart = () => {
711: 			if (this.ctx.focusedAgentId) {
712: 				this.#handleFocusedLeftTap();
713: 				return;
714: 			}
715: 			if (this.#detectLeftDoubleTap()) {
716: 				this.ctx.showAgentHub({ requireContent: true, armCloseTap: true });
717: 			}
718: 		};
719: 
720: 		this.#setupEnhancedPaste();
721: 
722: 		this.ctx.editor.onChange = (text: string) => {
723: 			this.#draftText = text;
724: 			const wasBashMode = this.ctx.isBashMode;
725: 			const wasPythonMode = this.ctx.isPythonMode;
726: 			const trimmed = text.trimStart();
727: 			this.ctx.isBashMode = trimmed.startsWith("!");
728: 			this.ctx.isPythonMode = parsePythonCommandInput(trimmed) !== undefined;
729: 			if (wasBashMode !== this.ctx.isBashMode || wasPythonMode !== this.ctx.isPythonMode) {
730: 				this.ctx.updateEditorBorderColor();
731: 			}
732: 			// Editor input repaints through the scoped fast path (only the editor
733: 			// component). The attachment chips band lives outside the editor, so a
734: 			// visibility change — a chip pasted in or its token deleted — must escape
735: 			// the fast path with a full render or the band goes stale.
736: 			const chipsSignature = this.ctx.editor
737: 				.composerChips()
738: 				.map(chip => `${chip.kind}${chip.n}`)
739: 				.join(",");
740: 			if (chipsSignature !== this.#lastChipsSignature) {
741: 				this.#lastChipsSignature = chipsSignature;
742: 				this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
743: 			}
744: 		};
745: 	}

747: 	#handleFocusedLeftTap(): void {
748: 		if (this.#detectLeftDoubleTap()) {
749: 			void this.ctx.unfocusSession();
750: 		}
751: 	}
752: 
753: 	/**
754: 	 * Inline click-to-focus (`tui.mouse`): left-clicks on live subagent cards
755: 	 * and HUD rows focus that agent in one action, and pointer motion lights up
756: 	 * the hover band on the target under the cursor. Every SGR report is consumed
757: 	 * while inline tracking owns the terminal so button/wheel bytes never reach
758: 	 * the editor as typed input; clicks on chrome simply swallow.
759: 	 */
760: 	#handleInlineMouse(data: string): { consume?: boolean; data?: string } | undefined {
761: 		if (!data.startsWith("\x1b[<")) return undefined;
762: 		if (!settings.get("tui.mouse")) return undefined;
763: 		if (this.ctx.ui.hasOverlay()) return undefined;
764: 		const event = parseSgrMouse(data);
765: 		if (!event) return undefined;
766: 		if (event.motion) this.#updateHoverHighlight(event.row);
767: 		else if (event.leftClick) this.#focusClickedAgent(event.row);
768: 		return { consume: true };
769: 	}
770: 
771: 	/**
772: 	 * Track the hovered click target, repainting only when it changes. The band
773: 	 * is id-anchored in the composer, so it follows an agent whose rows shift
774: 	 * while streaming; pointing at chrome clears it.
775: 	 */
776: 	#updateHoverHighlight(screenRow: number): void {
777: 		const hovered = this.#viewportCandidates(screenRow)[0];
778: 		if (hovered === this.#lastHoverClickId) return;
779: 		this.#lastHoverClickId = hovered;
780: 		this.ctx.setClickHoverId(hovered);
781: 		this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
782: 	}
783: 
784: 	// Candidates under a screen row, or none when the published viewport is
785: 	// empty (resize transactions) or the row falls outside it: routing stale
786: 	// spans would highlight or focus an unrelated agent from old rows.
787: 	#viewportCandidates(screenRow: number): string[] {
788: 		const viewport = this.ctx.ui.getMutableViewport();
789: 		const local = screenRow - viewport.top;
790: 		if (viewport.length === 0 || local < 0 || local >= viewport.length) return [];
791: 		return this.ctx.resolveViewportClickCandidates(local);
792: 	}
793: 
794: 	/**
795: 	 * Forget the last hovered target without repainting. Disabling mouse
796: 	 * capture clears the composer's band, but with reporting off no motion
797: 	 * event will ever refresh this cache — so a re-enable plus motion over
798: 	 * the same card would look unchanged and skip restoring the band.
799: 	 */
800: 	clearHoverHighlight(): void {
801: 		this.#lastHoverClickId = undefined;
802: 	}
803: 
804: 	#focusClickedAgent(screenRow: number): void {
805: 		const candidates = this.#viewportCandidates(screenRow);
806: 		if (candidates.length === 0) return;
807: 		const refs = AgentRegistry.global().list();
808: 		const scoped = refs.filter(ref => candidates.includes(ref.id));
809: 		// A live agent wins over the expander sentinel: task names are
810: 		// user-controlled, so an agent id can equal the toggle id. The toggle
811: 		// row itself names no agent and still toggles.
812: 		if (candidates.includes(PINNED_HUD_TOGGLE_ID) && scoped.length === 0) {
813: 			this.ctx.togglePinnedHudExpanded();
814: 			return;
815: 		}
816: 		// No global fallback: when every candidate is gone (aborted, released),
817: 		// focusing an unrelated recent agent would open something other than
818: 		// what the click displayed.
819: 		const nextId = pickRecentFocusableAgentId(scoped, this.ctx.focusedAgentId);
820: 		if (nextId === undefined) {
821: 			this.ctx.showStatus("That subagent is gone — open the hub for live agents");
822: 			return;
823: 		}
824: 		this.#focusResolvedAgent(nextId);
825: 	}
826: 
827: 	/** Focus a resolved agent id, ignoring already-viewing and surfacing errors as status. */
828: 	#focusResolvedAgent(nextId: string): void {
829: 		if (nextId === this.ctx.focusedAgentId) {
830: 			// Reaffirming the current view is still the user's latest click: a
831: 			// parked agent reviving from an older click must not land over it.
832: 			this.ctx.invalidatePendingFocus();
833: 			return;
834: 		}
835: 		void this.ctx.focusAgentSession(nextId).catch((error: unknown) => {
836: 			this.ctx.showStatus(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
837: 		});
838: 	}
839: 
840: 	/**
841: 	 * Detect a deliberate double-← gesture, rejecting terminal-synthesized arrow
842: 	 * bursts. Returns true only on the *second* tap of a fresh sequence when it
843: 	 * lands a human-plausible interval after the first
844: 	 * (`[LEFT_DOUBLE_TAP_MIN_GAP_MS, LEFT_DOUBLE_TAP_MAX_GAP_MS)`). Taps closer
845: 	 * than the lower bound, or any third-and-later tap before a quiet gap, are a
846: 	 * burst and never fire — so a stray click that makes the terminal emit a run
847: 	 * of ← keys can no longer pop the Agent Hub.
848: 	 */
849: 	#detectLeftDoubleTap(): boolean {
850: 		const now = Date.now();
851: 		const sinceLast = now - this.ctx.lastLeftTapTime;
852: 		this.ctx.lastLeftTapTime = now;
853: 		if (sinceLast >= LEFT_DOUBLE_TAP_MAX_GAP_MS) {
854: 			// Quiet gap: this tap starts a fresh sequence.
855: 			this.#leftTapCount = 1;
856: 			return false;
857: 		}
858: 		this.#leftTapCount += 1;
859: 		if (this.#leftTapCount === 2 && sinceLast >= LEFT_DOUBLE_TAP_MIN_GAP_MS) {
860: 			// Exactly two taps, the second a human-plausible interval after the first.
861: 			this.#leftTapCount = 0;
862: 			this.ctx.lastLeftTapTime = 0;
863: 			return true;
864: 		}
865: 		return false;
866: 	}
867: 
868: 	#setupEnhancedPaste(): void {
869: 		if (this.#enhancedPaste) return;
870: 
871: 		this.#enhancedPaste = new EnhancedPasteController({
872: 			write: data => this.ctx.ui.terminal.write(data),
873: 			pasteText: text => {
874: 				// Route enhanced-paste text to the currently focused component when it
875: 				// exposes a `pasteText` hook (modal Input prompts: OAuth API-key entry,
876: 				// Perplexity OTP, GitHub Enterprise URL, manual redirect URL). Falling
877: 				// back to the main editor would have buried the text in the detached
878: 				// editor while the modal Input had focus (#2127).
879: 				const focused = this.ctx.ui.getFocused();
880: 				const target = focused && focused !== this.ctx.editor && hasPasteText(focused) ? focused : this.ctx.editor;
881: 				target.pasteText(text);
882: 				this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
883: 			},
884: 			pasteImage: async image => {
885: 				// Images can only land in the main editor — when a modal Input is
886: 				// focused, refuse rather than dump the binary blob in a hidden buffer.
887: 				const focused = this.ctx.ui.getFocused();
888: 				if (focused && focused !== this.ctx.editor && hasPasteText(focused)) {
889: 					this.ctx.showStatus("Image paste is not supported in this prompt");
890: 					return;
891: 				}
892: 				await this.#normalizeAndInsertPastedImage(image, `Unsupported pasted image format: ${image.mimeType}`);
893: 			},
894: 			showStatus: message => this.ctx.showStatus(message),
895: 		});
896: 		this.ctx.ui.addInputListener(data => (this.#enhancedPaste?.handleInput(data) ? { consume: true } : undefined));
897: 		this.ctx.ui.addStartListener(() => this.#enhancedPaste?.enable());
898: 	}
899: 
900: 	/** Enforce the deleted-chip contract at submit time: images whose inline token was removed
901: 	 *  from the draft are dropped, and surviving markers are renumbered to the dense 1..K the
902: 	 *  positional `[Image #N] ↔ images[N-1]` mapping requires. Returns the rewritten text. */
903: 	#compactDraftImages(text: string): string {
904: 		const editor = this.ctx.editor;
905: 		const compacted = compactImageMarkers(text, editor.pendingImages.length);
906: 		if (!compacted) return text;
907: 		editor.pendingImages = compacted.keep.map(i => editor.pendingImages[i]);
908: 		editor.pendingImageLinks = compacted.keep.map(i => editor.pendingImageLinks[i]);
909: 		editor.imageLinks = editor.pendingImageLinks.length > 0 ? editor.pendingImageLinks : undefined;
910: 		return compacted.text.trim();
911: 	}
912: 
913: 	setupEditorSubmitHandler(): void {
914: 		this.ctx.editor.onSubmit = async (text: string) => {
915: 			text = this.#compactDraftImages(text.trim());
916: 			const hasPendingImages = this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.length > 0;
917: 			if ((!isSettingsInitialized() || settings.get("emojiAutocomplete")) && text) text = expandEmoticons(text);
918: 
919: 			// Focused subagent session: the editor is a plain chat box for it.
920: 			// Everything below (continue shortcuts, slash/bash/python, loop,
921: 			// compaction queueing) is main-session-only.
922: 			if (this.ctx.focusedAgentId) {
923: 				await this.#submitToFocusedSession(text, "steer");
924: 				return;
925: 			}
926: 
927: 			// Empty submit while streaming with queued messages: abort the active
928: 			// turn and let the post-unwind drain deliver the agent-core queue.
929: 			if (!text && !hasPendingImages && this.ctx.session.isStreaming) {
930: 				if (this.ctx.session.queuedMessageCount > 0) {
931: 					const aborting = this.ctx.session.abort({ reason: USER_INTERRUPT_LABEL });
932: 					await aborting;
933: 					this.ctx.updatePendingMessagesDisplay();
934: 					this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
935: 				}
936: 				return;
937: 			}
938: 
939: 			if (!text && !hasPendingImages) return;
940: 
941: 			// Continue shortcuts: "." or "c" resume the agent with a hidden agent-authored
942: 			// developer directive (no visible user message) instead of an empty turn, so the
943: 			// model continues the prior intent rather than second-guessing the interrupt.
944: 			if (text === "." || text === "c") {
945: 				if (this.ctx.onInputCallback) {
946: 					this.ctx.editor.clearDraft();
947: 					this.ctx.onInputCallback({
948: 						text: manualContinuePrompt,
949: 						cancelled: false,
950: 						started: true,
951: 						synthetic: true,
952: 						userInitiated: true,
953: 					});
954: 				}
955: 				return;
956: 			}
957: 
958: 			const runner = this.ctx.session.extensionRunner;
959: 			let inputImages = this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.length > 0 ? [...this.ctx.editor.pendingImages] : undefined;
960: 			let inputImageLinks =
961: 				this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks.length > 0 ? [...this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks] : undefined;
962: 			let hasInputImages = (inputImages?.length ?? 0) > 0;
963: 			const submittedImages = inputImages;
964: 
965: 			if (runner?.hasHandlers("input")) {
966: 				const result = await runner.emitInput(text, inputImages, "interactive");
967: 				if (result?.handled) {
968: 					this.ctx.editor.clearDraft();
969: 					return;
970: 				}
971: 				if (result?.text !== undefined) {
972: 					text = result.text.trim();
973: 				}
974: 				if (result?.images !== undefined) {
975: 					inputImages = result.images;
976: 					inputImageLinks = await materializeImageReferenceLinks(
977: 						inputImages,
978: 						this.ctx.sessionManager.putBlob.bind(this.ctx.sessionManager),
979: 					);
980: 				}
981: 				hasInputImages = (inputImages?.length ?? 0) > 0;
982: 			}
983: 			const submittedMode = parseSlashCommand(text)?.name;
984: 			const draftDetached =
985: 				submittedMode === "plan" ||
986: 				submittedMode === "vibe" ||
987: 				submittedMode === "goal" ||
988: 				submittedMode === "guided-goal";
989: 			if (
990: 				draftDetached &&
991: 				submittedImages?.length &&
992: 				submittedImages.every((image, index) => this.ctx.editor.pendingImages[index] === image)
993: 			) {
994: 				this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.splice(0, submittedImages.length);
995: 				this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks.splice(0, submittedImages.length);
996: 				this.ctx.editor.imageLinks =
997: 					this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks.length > 0 ? this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks : undefined;
998: 			}
999: 
1000: 			if (!text && !hasInputImages) return;
1001: 
1002: 			const queueBody = parseQueueShorthand(text);
1003: 			if (queueBody !== undefined) {
1004: 				await this.#queueForYield(queueBody, {
1005: 					historyText: text,
1006: 					images: inputImages,
1007: 					imageLinks: inputImageLinks,
1008: 				});
1009: 				return;
1010: 			}
1011: 
1012: 			// Handle built-in slash commands
1013: 			if (text) {
1014: 				this.#recordSlashCommandUsage(text);
1015: 				const input =
1016: 					(inputImages?.length ?? 0) > 0 || (inputImageLinks?.length ?? 0) > 0
1017: 						? { images: inputImages, imageLinks: inputImageLinks }
1018: 						: undefined;
1019: 				const slashResult = await executeBuiltinSlashCommand(text, { ctx: this.ctx, input, draftDetached });
1020: 				if (slashResult === true) {
1021: 					if (!shouldSkipHistory(text)) this.ctx.editor.addToHistory(text);
1022: 					return;
1023: 				}
1024: 				if (typeof slashResult === "string") {
1025: 					// Command handled but returned remaining text to use as prompt.
1026: 					// Record the original slash command text so Up Arrow recalls
1027: 					// "/loop 10 fix bug" rather than just "fix bug".
1028: 					if (!shouldSkipHistory(text)) this.ctx.editor.addToHistory(text);
1029: 					text = slashResult;
1030: 				}
1031: 			}
1032: 
1033: 			// Collab guest: prompts execute on the host; local slash/skill/bash/
1034: 			// python execution is host-only (builtins are gated inside
1035: 			// executeBuiltinSlashCommand, which already consumed allowed ones).
1036: 			if (this.ctx.collabGuest) {
1037: 				if (text.startsWith("/")) {
1038: 					this.ctx.showStatus(`${text.split(/\s+/, 1)[0]} is host-only during a collab session`);
1039: 					this.ctx.editor.setText("");
1040: 					return;
1041: 				}
1042: 				if (text.startsWith("!") || parsePythonCommandInput(text)) {
1043: 					this.ctx.showStatus("Local execution is host-only during a collab session");
1044: 					this.ctx.editor.setText("");
1045: 					return;
1046: 				}
1047: 				if (this.ctx.collabGuest.readOnly) {
1048: 					// Keep the typed text: the prompt was not consumed.
1049: 					this.ctx.showStatus("This collab link is read-only — prompting is disabled");
1050: 					return;
1051: 				}
1052: 				const images = inputImages && inputImages.length > 0 ? [...inputImages] : undefined;
1053: 				this.ctx.editor.clearDraft(text);
1054: 				// No local render: the prompt comes back from the host as a
1055: 				// collab-prompt event/entry and renders with the author badge.
1056: 				this.ctx.collabGuest.sendPrompt(text, images);
1057: 				return;
1058: 			}
1059: 
1060: 			// Handle skill commands (/skill:name [args]). Enter ⇒ steer (matches the
1061: 			// free-text Enter semantics below); Ctrl+Enter routes through `handleFollowUp`.
1062: 			// During compaction, queue immediately so bash/python/loop-mode branches do
1063: 			// not consume the skill before the compaction-resume path re-parses it.
1064: 			if (text && isKnownSkillCommand(this.ctx, text)) {
1065: 				// Capture here too: this branch's own early returns below would
1066: 				// otherwise skip the non-skill capture further down.
1067: 				if (this.ctx.loopModeEnabled) {
1068: 					this.ctx.setLoopPrompt(text);
1069: 				}
1070: 				if (this.ctx.session.isCompacting) {
1071: 					const images = inputImages && inputImages.length > 0 ? [...inputImages] : undefined;
1072: 					this.ctx.queueCompactionMessage(text, "steer", images);
1073: 					return;
1074: 				}
1075: 				if (await this.#invokeSkillCommand(text, "steer", inputImages, inputImageLinks)) {
1076: 					// The dispatch above ran the turn inline without resolving the input
1077: 					// callback, so nothing re-enters `getUserInput` to arm the next
1078: 					// iteration. Arm it here, now that the turn has settled.
1079: 					if (this.ctx.loopModeEnabled) {
1080: 						this.ctx.armLoopAutoSubmit();
1081: 					}
1082: 					return;
1083: 				}
1084: 			}
1085: 
1086: 			// Handle bash command (! for normal, !! for excluded from context)
1087: 			if (text.startsWith("!")) {
1088: 				const isExcluded = text.startsWith("!!");
1089: 				const command = isExcluded ? text.slice(2).trim() : text.slice(1).trim();
1090: 				if (command) {
1091: 					if (this.ctx.session.isBashRunning) {
1092: 						this.ctx.showWarning("A bash command is already running. Press Esc to cancel it first.");
1093: 						this.ctx.editor.setText(text);
1094: 						return;
1095: 					}
1096: 					this.ctx.editor.addToHistory(text);
1097: 					await this.ctx.handleBashCommand(command, isExcluded);
1098: 					this.ctx.isBashMode = false;
1099: 					this.ctx.updateEditorBorderColor();
1100: 					return;
1101: 				}
1102: 			}
1103: 
1104: 			// Handle python command (`$ <code>` for normal, `$$ <code>` for excluded from context).
1105: 			// Shell-style variables such as `$HOME` are normal prose unless a space follows the sigil.
1106: 			const pythonCommand = parsePythonCommandInput(text);
1107: 			if (pythonCommand) {
1108: 				const { code, isExcluded } = pythonCommand;
1109: 				if (code) {
1110: 					if (this.ctx.session.isEvalRunning) {
1111: 						this.ctx.showWarning("A Python execution is already running. Press Esc to cancel it first.");
1112: 						this.ctx.editor.setText(text);
1113: 						return;
1114: 					}
1115: 					this.ctx.editor.addToHistory(text);
1116: 					await this.ctx.handlePythonCommand(code, isExcluded);
1117: 					this.ctx.isPythonMode = false;
1118: 					this.ctx.updateEditorBorderColor();
1119: 					return;
1120: 				}
1121: 			}
1122: 
1123: 			// Queue input during compaction
1124: 			if (this.ctx.session.isCompacting) {
1125: 				const images = inputImages && inputImages.length > 0 ? [...inputImages] : undefined;
1126: 				this.ctx.queueCompactionMessage(text, "steer", images);
1127: 				// An inline `/loop` body queued here arms the loop only when it is
1128: 				// an actual model prompt. Skill/bash/python bodies never reach this
1129: 				// branch, but an extension-command body would otherwise be retained
1130: 				// as loopPrompt while the drain executes it locally — and idle
1131: 				// submissions never arm commands.
1132: 				if (submittedMode === "loop" && !this.#isLocalExtensionCommand(text)) this.ctx.setLoopPrompt(text);
1133: 				return;

1555: 				imageLinks: draftImageLinks,
1556: 				optimistic: true,
1557: 				propagateErrors: true,
1558: 			});
1559: 			if (!dispatched) restoreDraft();
1560: 			return dispatched;
1561: 		} catch (error) {
1562: 			restoreDraft();
1563: 			this.ctx.showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
1564: 			return true;
1565: 		} finally {
1566: 			if (this.ctx.session.isStreaming) {
1567: 				this.ctx.updatePendingMessagesDisplay();
1568: 				this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
1569: 			}
1570: 		}
1571: 	}
1572: 
1573: 	async handleRetry(): Promise<void> {
1574: 		if (this.ctx.collabGuest) {
1575: 			this.ctx.showStatus("/retry is host-only during a collab session");
1576: 			return;
1577: 		}
1578: 		const didRetry = await this.ctx.viewSession.retry();
1579: 		if (didRetry) {
1580: 			this.ctx.editor.clearDraft();
1581: 		} else {
1582: 			this.ctx.showStatus("Nothing to retry");
1583: 		}
1584: 	}

1586: 	/** Queue `/queue` input behind an active turn, or start it immediately when idle. */
1587: 	async handleQueueCommand(text: string): Promise<void> {
1588: 		const images = this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.length > 0 ? [...this.ctx.editor.pendingImages] : undefined;
1589: 		const imageLinks =
1590: 			images && this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks.length > 0 ? [...this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks] : undefined;
1591: 		await this.#queueForYield(text, { images, imageLinks });
1592: 	}
1593: 
1594: 	async #queueForYield(
1595: 		text: string,
1596: 		options: {
1597: 			historyText?: string;
1598: 			images?: ImageContent[];
1599: 			imageLinks?: (string | undefined)[];
1600: 		},
1601: 	): Promise<void> {
1602: 		const splitMessages = splitQueuedMessages(text);
1603: 		if (splitMessages.length === 0 && !options.images?.length) {
1604: 			this.ctx.editor.clearDraft();
1605: 			this.ctx.showWarning("Usage: /queue <message> (or start a prompt with -> / =>)");
1606: 			return;
1607: 		}
1608: 
1609: 		const messages = splitMessages.length > 0 ? splitMessages : [""];
1610: 		const originalDraft = this.ctx.editor.getText();
1611: 		const images = options.images?.length ? [...options.images] : undefined;
1612: 		const imageLinks = options.imageLinks
1613: 			? [...options.imageLinks]
1614: 			: images
1615: 				? images.map(() => undefined)
1616: 				: undefined;
1617: 		this.ctx.editor.clearDraft(options.historyText);
1618: 
1619: 		if (this.ctx.session.isCompacting) {
1620: 			for (let index = 0; index < messages.length; index++) {
1621: 				this.ctx.compactionQueuedMessages.push({
1622: 					text: messages[index] ?? "",
1623: 					mode: "followUp",
1624: 					images: index === 0 ? images : undefined,
1625: 				});
1626: 			}
1627: 			this.ctx.updatePendingMessagesDisplay();
1628: 			this.ctx.showStatus(
1629: 				messages.length === 1
1630: 					? "Queued message for after compaction"
1631: 					: `Queued ${messages.length} messages for after compaction`,
1632: 			);
1633: 			this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
1634: 			return;
1635: 		}
1636: 
1637: 		const startImmediately = !this.ctx.session.isStreaming && this.ctx.session.queuedMessageCount === 0;
1638: 		let queuedCount = 0;
1639: 		try {
1640: 			if (startImmediately && this.ctx.onInputCallback) {
1641: 				const first = messages[0] ?? "";
1642: 				const submission = this.ctx.startPendingSubmission({
1643: 					text: first,
1644: 					images,
1645: 					imageLinks,
1646: 					streamingBehavior: "followUp",
1647: 				});
1648: 				this.ctx.onInputCallback(submission);
1649: 				queuedCount = 1;
1650: 			}
1651: 			while (queuedCount < messages.length) {
1652: 				const message = messages[queuedCount] ?? "";
1653: 				const queuedImages = queuedCount === 0 ? images : undefined;
1654: 				await this.ctx.withLocalSubmission(
1655: 					message,
1656: 					async () => {
1657: 						if (startImmediately && queuedCount === 0) {
1658: 							await this.ctx.session.prompt(message, {
1659: 								images: queuedImages,
1660: 								streamingBehavior: "followUp",
1661: 							});
1662: 						} else {
1663: 							await this.ctx.session.followUp(message, queuedImages);
1664: 						}
1665: 					},
1666: 					{ imageCount: queuedImages?.length ?? 0 },
1667: 				);
1668: 				queuedCount++;
1669: 			}
1670: 		} catch (error) {
1671: 			if (queuedCount === 0) {
1672: 				this.ctx.editor.setText(originalDraft);
1673: 				if (images) {
1674: 					this.ctx.editor.pendingImages = images;
1675: 					this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks = imageLinks ?? images.map(() => undefined);
1676: 					this.ctx.editor.imageLinks = this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks;
1677: 				}
1678: 			} else {
1679: 				const remaining = messages.slice(queuedCount);
1680: 				const restored =
1681: 					remaining.length === 1
1682: 						? `=> ${remaining[0]}`
1683: 						: `=>\n${remaining
1684: 								.map((message, index) => `${index + 1}. ${message.replaceAll("\n", "\n   ")}`)
1685: 								.join("\n")}`;
1686: 				this.ctx.editor.setText(restored);
1687: 			}
1688: 			this.ctx.showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
1689: 		}
1690: 
1691: 		this.ctx.updatePendingMessagesDisplay();
1692: 		if (queuedCount === messages.length) {
1693: 			this.ctx.showStatus(
1694: 				startImmediately
1695: 					? queuedCount === 1
1696: 						? "Sent queued message"
1697: 						: `Sent first message; queued ${queuedCount - 1} for later yields`
1698: 					: queuedCount === 1
1699: 						? "Queued message for when the agent yields"
1700: 						: `Queued ${queuedCount} messages for when the agent yields`,
1701: 			);
1702: 		}
1703: 		this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
1704: 	}
1705: 
1706: 	/** Send editor text as a follow-up message (queued behind current stream). */
1707: 	async handleFollowUp(): Promise<void> {
1708: 		let text = this.#compactDraftImages(this.ctx.editor.getExpandedText().trim());
1709: 		const images = this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.length > 0 ? [...this.ctx.editor.pendingImages] : undefined;
1710: 		const imageLinks =
1711: 			images && this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks.length > 0 ? [...this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks] : undefined;
1712: 		if (!text && !images) return;
1713: 
1714: 		// Focused subagent session: follow-ups go to it; non-chat input is gated.
1715: 		if (this.ctx.focusedAgentId) {
1716: 			await this.#submitToFocusedSession(text, "followUp");
1717: 			return;
1718: 		}
1719: 
1720: 		// Compaction first: while compacting, free text gets queued via
1721: 		// `queueCompactionMessage`, and `/skill:*` rides the same queue so a
1722: 		// skill typed during compaction is not lost or short-circuited through
1723: 		// `promptCustomMessage`. The compaction-resume path re-parses the
1724: 		// queued text into a user-attributed skill invocation before delivery.
1725: 		if (this.ctx.session.isCompacting) {
1726: 			const images = this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.length > 0 ? [...this.ctx.editor.pendingImages] : undefined;
1727: 			this.ctx.queueCompactionMessage(text, "followUp", images);
1728: 			return;
1729: 		}
1730: 
1731: 		if (text) {
1732: 			const input = (images?.length ?? 0) > 0 || (imageLinks?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? { images, imageLinks } : undefined;
1733: 			const slashResult = await executeBuiltinSlashCommand(text, { ctx: this.ctx, input });
1734: 			if (slashResult === true) {
1735: 				if (!shouldSkipHistory(text)) this.ctx.editor.addToHistory(text);
1736: 				return;
1737: 			}
1738: 			if (typeof slashResult === "string") {
1739: 				// Command handled but returned remaining text to use as prompt.
1740: 				// Record the original slash command text so Up Arrow recalls it.
1741: 				if (!shouldSkipHistory(text)) this.ctx.editor.addToHistory(text);
1742: 				text = slashResult;
1743: 			}
1744: 		}
1745: 
1746: 		// Skill commands invoke through the custom-message path regardless of
1747: 		// which keybinding submitted them. Enter routes them as `steer`;
1748: 		// Ctrl+Enter (this handler) routes them as `followUp`.
1749: 		if (text && (await this.#invokeSkillCommand(text, "followUp", images, imageLinks))) {
1750: 			return;
1751: 		}
1752: 
1753: 		// Hand the message back on dispatch failure (model/API-key validation,
1754: 		// queue rejection): restore both text AND pending images so an image-only
1755: 		// or text+image draft can be retried, mirroring the main submit error path.
1756: 		const restoreOnError = (error: unknown) => {
1757: 			if (images && images.length > 0) {
1758: 				this.ctx.editor.pendingImages = [...images];
1759: 				this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks = imageLinks ? [...imageLinks] : images.map(() => undefined);
1760: 				this.ctx.editor.imageLinks = this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks;
1761: 			}
1762: 			// Collapse restores the chip tokens (and their band cards) for the failed draft.
1763: 			this.ctx.editor.setCollapsedText(text);
1764: 			this.ctx.showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
1765: 		};
1766: 
1767: 		if (this.ctx.session.isStreaming) {
1768: 			this.ctx.editor.clearDraft(text);
1769: 			try {
1770: 				await this.ctx.withLocalSubmission(
1771: 					text,
1772: 					() => this.ctx.session.prompt(text, { streamingBehavior: "followUp", images }),
1773: 					{ imageCount: images?.length ?? 0 },
1774: 				);
1775: 			} catch (error) {
1776: 				restoreOnError(error);
1777: 			}
1778: 			this.ctx.updatePendingMessagesDisplay();
1779: 			this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
1780: 			return;
1781: 		}
1782: 
1783: 		// Not streaming — just submit normally
1784: 		this.ctx.editor.clearDraft(text);
1785: 		try {
1786: 			await this.ctx.withLocalSubmission(text, () => this.ctx.session.prompt(text, { images }), {
1787: 				imageCount: images?.length ?? 0,
1788: 			});
1789: 		} catch (error) {
1790: 			restoreOnError(error);
1791: 		}
1792: 	}
1793: 
1794: 	restoreQueuedMessagesToEditor(options?: { abort?: boolean; currentText?: string }): number {
1795: 		this.ctx.locallySubmittedUserSignatures.clear();
1796: 		// On Esc (abort) drop non-user internal steers so the post-abort drain can't
1797: 		// auto-resume; plain Alt+Up dequeue preserves them for the continuing stream.
1798: 		const { steering, followUp } = this.ctx.session.clearQueue({ forInterrupt: options?.abort });
1799: 		// Messages typed while compacting live in `compactionQueuedMessages`, not the
1800: 		// agent queue `clearQueue()` drains — but the pending bar shows the same
1801: 		// "Alt+Up to edit" hint for them (ui-helpers `updatePendingMessagesDisplay`).
1802: 		// Drain them here too so the restore recovers every message the hint
1803: 		// advertises; otherwise a skill/text queued during compaction is stranded.
1804: 		const compactionQueued = this.ctx.compactionQueuedMessages;
1805: 		this.ctx.compactionQueuedMessages = [];
1806: 		const allQueued = [
1807: 			...steering,
1808: 			...compactionQueued.filter(e => e.mode === "steer").map(e => ({ text: e.text, images: e.images })),
1809: 			...followUp,
1810: 			...compactionQueued.filter(e => e.mode === "followUp").map(e => ({ text: e.text, images: e.images })),
1811: 		];
1812: 		const restored = this.#restoreEntriesToEditor(allQueued, options?.currentText);
1813: 		if (options?.abort) {
1814: 			void this.ctx.session.abort({ reason: USER_INTERRUPT_LABEL });
1815: 		}
1816: 		return restored;
1817: 	}
1818: 
1819: 	/**
1820: 	 * Merge queued entries (oldest→newest) ahead of the current draft, folding
1821: 	 * their images back into the pending-image buffer and refreshing the pending
1822: 	 * bar. Shared by the Alt+Up dequeue (one entry) and the Esc restore-all path.
1823: 	 * Returns the number of entries restored.
1824: 	 */
1825: 	#restoreEntriesToEditor(entries: RestoredQueuedMessage[], currentText?: string): number {
1826: 		if (entries.length === 0) {
1827: 			this.ctx.updatePendingMessagesDisplay();
1828: 			return 0;
1829: 		}
1830: 		// Image markers are positional: `[Image #N]` ↔ `pendingImages[N-1]`
1831: 		// (legacy drafts may still carry a trailing `attachment://N`). Each queued
1832: 		// message numbered its references against its own local image list
1833: 		// (1..K). Because we prepend the queued text but append the queued images
1834: 		// to `pendingImages`, any existing draft images (M of them) — plus images
1835: 		// already pulled in by earlier queued messages — shift the slot index that
1836: 		// every reference must point to. Bumping each message's marker and URI
1837: 		// indices by the running offset keeps the merged text aligned with the merged
1838: 		// `pendingImages` order; draft markers stay valid because draft images
1839: 		// keep their original positions.
1840: 		const queuedImages = entries.flatMap(e => e.images ?? []);
1841: 		let queuedText: string;
1842: 		if (queuedImages.length > 0) {
1843: 			const parts: string[] = [];
1844: 			let imageOffset = this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.length;
1845: 			for (const entry of entries) {
1846: 				parts.push(shiftImageMarkers(entry.text, imageOffset));
1847: 				if (entry.images && entry.images.length > 0) imageOffset += entry.images.length;
1848: 			}
1849: 			queuedText = parts.join("\n\n");
1850: 		} else {
1851: 			queuedText = entries.map(e => e.text).join("\n\n");
1852: 		}
1853: 		const current = currentText ?? this.ctx.editor.getText();
1854: 		const combinedText = [queuedText, current].filter(t => t.trim()).join("\n\n");
1855: 		// Hand queued images back to the pending-image buffer first (links are
1856: 		// re-materialized lazily), then set the text: setCollapsedText folds the
1857: 		// renumbered `[Image #N, WxH]` references back into chip tokens, and the
1858: 		// collapse only recognizes indices within the merged pendingImages range.
1859: 		if (queuedImages.length > 0) {
1860: 			this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.push(...queuedImages);
1861: 			this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks.push(...queuedImages.map(() => undefined));
1862: 			this.ctx.editor.imageLinks = this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks;
1863: 		}
1864: 		this.ctx.editor.setCollapsedText(combinedText);
1865: 		this.ctx.updatePendingMessagesDisplay();
1866: 		return entries.length;
1867: 	}
1868: 
1869: 	async #insertPendingImage(imageData: ImageContent, source?: ImageAttachmentSource): Promise<void> {
1870: 		const image: ImageContent = source
1871: 			? tagImageAttachmentSource(imageData, source.path, source.kind)
1872: 			: { type: "image", data: imageData.data, mimeType: imageData.mimeType };
1873: 		// File-backed attachments link to their file (so the chip opens it); payloads
1874: 		// without one (a failed clipboard persist) materialize a clickable blob copy.
1875: 		const imageLink =
1876: 			source?.path ??
1877: 			(
1878: 				await materializeImageReferenceLinks([image], this.ctx.sessionManager.putBlob.bind(this.ctx.sessionManager))
1879: 			)?.[0];
1880: 		this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.push(image);
1881: 		this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks.push(imageLink);
1882: 		this.ctx.editor.imageLinks = this.ctx.editor.pendingImageLinks;
1883: 		const imageNum = this.ctx.editor.pendingImages.length;
1884: 		const dims = await this.#imageDimensions(imageData);
1885: 		setCachedImageDimensions(image, dims ?? null);
1886: 		const kind = source?.kind ?? "image";
1887: 		// The buffer holds the compact chip token; the atom table expands it to the bracketed
1888: 		// marker (the wire/transcript format) on submit.
1889: 		const expansion = dims
1890: 			? `[${kind === "video" ? "Video" : "Image"} #${imageNum}, ${dims.width}x${dims.height}]`
1891: 			: `[${kind === "video" ? "Video" : "Image"} #${imageNum}]`;
1892: 		this.ctx.editor.insertAtom(chipLabel(kind, imageNum), expansion);
1893: 		this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
1894: 	}
1895: 
1896: 	/** Probe pixel dimensions for the marker label (`[Image #N, WxH]`). Returns undefined when the
1897: 	 *  header can't be decoded, so the caller falls back to a bare `[Image #N]`. */
1898: 	async #imageDimensions(image: ImageContent): Promise<{ width: number; height: number } | undefined> {
1899: 		try {
1900: 			const { width, height } = await new Bun.Image(Buffer.from(image.data, "base64")).metadata();
1901: 			if (width && height) return { width, height };
1902: 		} catch {
1903: 			// Unknown/corrupt header — fall back to a bare label.
1904: 		}
1905: 		return undefined;
1906: 	}
1907: 
1908: 	async #normalizePastedImage(image: ImageContent, unsupportedMessage: string): Promise<ImageContent | null> {
1909: 		let imageData = await ensureSupportedImageInput(image);
1910: 		if (!imageData) {
1911: 			this.ctx.showStatus(unsupportedMessage);
1912: 			return null;
1913: 		}
1914: 		if (settings.get("images.autoResize")) {
1915: 			try {
1916: 				const resized = await resizeImage({
1917: 					type: "image",
1918: 					data: imageData.data,
1919: 					mimeType: imageData.mimeType,
1920: 				});
1921: 				imageData = { type: "image", data: resized.data, mimeType: resized.mimeType };
1922: 			} catch {
1923: 				// Keep the normalized image when resize fails.
1924: 			}
1925: 		}
1926: 		return imageData;
1927: 	}
1928: 
1929: 	async #normalizeAndInsertPastedImage(
1930: 		image: ImageContent,
1931: 		unsupportedMessage: string,
1932: 		sourcePath?: string,
1933: 	): Promise<boolean> {
1934: 		const normalized = await this.#normalizePastedImage(image, unsupportedMessage);
1935: 		if (!normalized) return false;
1936: 		// Every attachment gets a file so tools can read, copy, or upload it: file-pasted
1937: 		// images keep their original path; clipboard bitmaps are committed to the session
1938: 		// and referenced by a relocation-safe `local://` URL. The reference reaches the
1939: 		// model via the hidden companion message (see AgentSession's attachment source notices).
1940: 		const filePath = sourcePath ?? (await this.#persistPastedImage(image));
1941: 		await this.#insertPendingImage(normalized, filePath ? { path: filePath, kind: "image" } : undefined);
1942: 		return true;
1943: 	}
1944: 
1945: 	/**
1946: 	 * Commit clipboard image bytes to the session's `local://` root (inside the session
1947: 	 * artifact directory), as pasted: full resolution, before model auto-resize. Named by
1948: 	 * content hash so re-pasting the same screenshot reuses one file. Returns the
1949: 	 * `local://` URL rather than an absolute path: `/move` relocates the artifact
1950: 	 * directory, and the URL resolves against the session's current root. Returns
1951: 	 * undefined when the write fails; the image still attaches, just without a reference.
1952: 	 */
1953: 	async #persistPastedImage(image: ImageContent): Promise<string | undefined> {
1954: 		const bytes = Buffer.from(image.data, "base64");
1955: 		const extension = blobExtensionForImageMimeType(image.mimeType) ?? "png";
1956: 		const url = `local://pasted-image-${Bun.hash(bytes).toString(16)}.${extension}`;
1957: 		try {
1958: 			const filePath = resolveLocalUrlToPath(url, {
1959: 				getArtifactsDir: () => this.ctx.sessionManager.getArtifactsDir(),
1960: 				getSessionId: () => this.ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId(),
1961: 			});
1962: 			await Bun.write(filePath, bytes);
1963: 			return url;
1964: 		} catch (error) {
1965: 			logger.warn("failed to persist pasted image", {
1966: 				error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
1967: 			});
1968: 			return undefined;
1969: 		}
1970: 	}
1971: 
1972: 	/**
1973: 	 * Win+Shift+S on Windows 11 leaves the screenshot bitmap on the clipboard
1974: 	 * while the terminal pastes a transient packaged-app TempState path
1975: 	 * (…\MicrosoftWindows.Client.Core_*\TempState\…) that is already gone — or
1976: 	 * never materialized — by the time we read it. Whenever a pasted image path
1977: 	 * can't be turned into an image locally, those clipboard bytes are the real
1978: 	 * payload, so prefer them before degrading to a text paste.
1979: 	 *
1980: 	 * Skipped over SSH: the clipboard read would hit the remote host, not the
1981: 	 * terminal that holds the screenshot. Returns true when the clipboard owned
1982: 	 * the outcome (image attached, or an unsupported-format status surfaced), so
1983: 	 * the caller stops without emitting its own degraded diagnostic.
1984: 	 */
1985: 	/**
1986: 	 * Attach a pasted video path as a contact-sheet preview grid through the
1987: 	 * image pipeline. A missing ffmpeg (or probe failure) degrades to a text
1988: 	 * paste with an actionable status; ENOENT propagates to the caller's
1989: 	 * clipboard-fallback handling.
1990: 	 */
1991: 	async #insertPendingVideoPreview(pastedPath: string): Promise<void> {
1992: 		try {
1993: 			const absolutePath = resolveReadPath(pastedPath, this.ctx.sessionManager.getCwd());
1994: 			const meta = await probeVideo(absolutePath);
1995: 			const sheet = await buildVideoContactSheetPng(absolutePath, meta);
1996: 			const preview = await this.#normalizePastedImage(
1997: 				{ type: "image", data: sheet.png.data, mimeType: sheet.png.mimeType },
1998: 				"Unsupported pasted video preview format",
1999: 			);
2000: 			if (preview) await this.#insertPendingImage(preview, { path: absolutePath, kind: "video" });
2001: 		} catch (error) {
2002: 			if (error instanceof VideoError) {
2003: 				this.ctx.editor.pasteText(pastedPath);
2004: 				this.ctx.ui.requestRender();
2005: 				this.ctx.showStatus(error.message);
2006: 				return;
2007: 			}
2008: 			throw error;
2009: 		}
2010: 	}
2011: 
2012: 	async #tryPasteClipboardImage(): Promise<boolean> {
2013: 		const env = process.env;
2014: 		if (env.SSH_CONNECTION || env.SSH_TTY || env.SSH_CLIENT) return false;
2015: 		try {
2016: 			const image = await this.clipboard.readImage();
2017: 			if (!image) return false;
2018: 			await this.#normalizeAndInsertPastedImage(
2019: 				{ type: "image", data: image.data.toBase64(), mimeType: image.mimeType },
2020: 				`Unsupported clipboard image format: ${image.mimeType}`,
2021: 			);
2022: 			return true;

# Kappa CLI package guidelines

## Build/Test

- **Run**: `bun run --conditions=browser ./src/index.ts`
- **Test**: `bun test` (all tests) or `bun test test/tool/tool.test.ts` (single test)
- **Typecheck**: `bun run typecheck` (runs `tsgo --noEmit`)

## Import Aliases

- `@/*` maps to `./src/*`
- `@tui/*` maps to `./src/cli/cmd/tui/*`

## Key Patterns

**Namespace modules** -- Code is organized as TypeScript namespaces, not classes. Each module exports a namespace with its Zod schemas, types, and functions:

```ts
export namespace Session {
  export const Info = z.object({ ... })
  export type Info = z.infer<typeof Info>
  export const create = fn(z.object({ ... }), async (input) => { ... })
}
```

**`Instance.state(init, dispose?)`** -- Per-project lazy singleton. Many modules register state this way. The state is tied to the project directory via `AsyncLocalStorage`:

```ts
const state = Instance.state(async () => {
  // initialized once per project, cached
  return { ... }
})
// later: (await state()).someValue
```

**Service-closure state vs. directory state** -- A value created in a service-layer closure, outside `InstanceState`, is shared by that service instance rather than keyed by request directory. The shared VS Code session paths use one active Snapshot service for the sidebar, Kappa tabs, and Agent Manager local worktree requests, so Snapshot `trackState` and its slow-track `asked` guard span those directories. Choosing **Continue with snapshots** resets the guard only when continued tracking returns a snapshot hash.

**`fn(schema, callback)`** -- Wraps functions with Zod input validation. Used for most exported functions:

```ts
export const get = fn(z.object({ id: z.string() }), async (input) => { ... })
```

**`Tool.define(id, init)`** -- All tools follow this pattern. The `init` returns `{ description, parameters, execute }`. Output is auto-truncated.

**`BusEvent.define(type, schema)` + `Bus.publish()`** -- In-process pub/sub event system for cross-module communication.

**`NamedError.create(name, schema)`** -- Structured errors with Zod schemas. Prefer these over throwing raw errors.

**`iife()`** -- Immediately-invoked function expression helper. Used to avoid `let` statements per style guide.

**Logging** -- Use `Log.create({ service: "name" })` pattern.

## Process Spawning (Windows)

On Windows, any `spawn`/`execFile` call without `windowsHide: true` will flash a cmd.exe console window at the user. Use `Process.spawn` from `src/util/process.ts` — it enforces `windowsHide: true` automatically. For `Bun.spawn`/`Bun.spawnSync`, pass `windowsHide` via the options object if the subprocess could create a visible console.

The MCP `StdioClientTransport` (third-party SDK) is handled separately via a process shim in `src/mcp/index.ts` that sets `process.type = "browser"` when running inside the VS Code extension (`KAPPA_PLATFORM=vscode`), which causes the SDK's internal `isElectron()` check to return `true` and enable `windowsHide`.

## Storage

Filesystem-based JSON, not a database. Data lives in `~/.local/share/kappa/storage/`. Keys are path arrays: `Storage.write(["session", projectID, sessionID], data)`.

## TUI

Built with **SolidJS + OpenTUI** (`@opentui/solid`) -- a terminal UI framework. JSX renders to the terminal using elements like `<box>`, `<text>`, `<scrollbox>`. The TUI communicates with the server via `@kappacode/sdk`.

## Server

Hono-based HTTP server with OpenAPI spec generation. SSE for real-time events. When you add/change routes, regenerate the SDK (see root AGENTS.md for the command).

## Providers and Models

Uses the **Vercel AI SDK** as the abstraction layer. Providers are loaded from a bundled map or dynamically installed at runtime. Models come from models.dev (external API), cached locally.

## Fork Isolation Rule

`opencode/` is a fork of upstream opencode. When a change must touch a shared upstream file, extract the Kappa-specific logic into a mirror file under `src/kappacode/<same/path>.ts` (tests under `test/kappacode/<same/path>.test.ts`) and call into it from the upstream file behind a single `kappacode_change` marker. Example: a Kappa override for `src/cli/cmd/tui/component/dialog-provider.tsx` lives at `src/kappacode/cli/cmd/tui/component/dialog-provider.tsx`. Avoid inlining Kappa-specific logic directly into shared upstream files. Files and directories whose path contains `kappacode` never need `kappacode_change` markers.
